in_marathi.name: Hema
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे River of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hema हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Hema is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘हेम’ (Hema) which means ‘river of God’. This name is believed to bring blessings of purity, abundance and divinity. Hema is also the name of the goddess of love, wealth and fertility in Hindu tradition.
